q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of gypsum board per square metre?
title: Gypsum board carbon footprint per sq m
short: Gypsum board needs heat twice: calcining the gypsum and drying the wet board. Divide the plant's fuel and electricity by square metres made, then add the facing paper and additives with supplier figures.
audience: Gypsum board plants and interior contractors

ul: Natural or FGD gypsum by weight.

p: Report per square metre by thickness. FGD gypsum from power plants replaces mined gypsum but the energy steps stay.

example.title: Worked example: gypsum board unit per sq m (one month)
lines: Plant total: 364,300 / 300,000 = 1.214 kg CO2 per sq m
Add gypsum, paper and additives for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
